summary: Backend-only verification of POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/email (new one-tap 'Email Invoice' button for maid subscriptions). Created a weekly svc-maid-fulltime subscription for Priya Verma (+919000000004), activated via /pay/mock, fetched invoice_id, then validated all 4 required endpoint contracts + PDF regression. 5/5 pytest tests pass.
verified_behaviour: POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/email body {} as owner (no email on file) → HTTP 400, detail mentions email (Hinglish: 'Koi email address nahi mila'). Clean 400, not 500.
POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/email body {"to":"notanemail"} as owner → HTTP 400, detail contains 'valid email'.
POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/email body {"to":"test@example.com"} as owner, SMTP not configured → HTTP 400, detail mentions configured/Integrations/SendGrid/SMTP. Never a 500.
POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/email as partner (+919000000003, different user) → HTTP 403 Not allowed.
Regression: GET /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf as owner → 200 application/pdf, %PDF magic bytes, >500 bytes (iteration_221 fix intact).
critical_code_review_comments: invoice_routes.py line 168-170: valid-email check only ensures '@' is present; a value like 'a@' would pass this guard and reach send_email. Not a blocker because send_email itself handles failures gracefully, but could be tightened with the service's _EMAIL_RE regex for consistent user-facing error messaging.

invoice_service.email_invoice() looks up partner/merchant email from the users table as a fallback, but for 'customer' audience it does NOT — matches the spec here (owner-less-email returns no_email), just worth noting.
test_credentials: Owner: +919000000004 (Priya Verma, email scrubbed via Mongo in fixture to satisfy 'no email on file' precondition); Partner: +919000000003 (Raj Kumar); OTP 123456.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 weekly maid subscription + mock payment transaction + subscription invoice for +919000000004 (invoice_id persists for retest convenience; not cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_email_endpoint.py. Must be run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env (or localhost:8001). Fixture scrubs Priya's email from the users collection via direct Mongo to guarantee the 'no_email' 400 path; seed re-adds it on next startup if applicable. SMTP is intentionally not configured in this env — expect email_not_configured 400s for any valid 'to'. All iteration_222 contract requirements verified.
